_comment: Monitors are identified by MultiMonitorTool's 'Short Monitor ID' (EDID vendor+product code),
the monitor serial number, or the \\.\DISPLAYn name. NEVER by a bare number: to MultiMonitorTool
a bare '2' means \\.\DISPLAY2, and Windows renumbers those on driver installs and hot-plugs.
List yours with:  .\MultiMonitorTool.exe /scomma monitors.csv   (columns Name, Short Monitor ID, Monitor Serial Number)
Or run:           .\switch-v2.ps1 -DryRun   which logs every monitor it can see.
_audio: audio is resolved by MONITOR: the display-audio endpoint that shares the monitor's PnP container ID.
That survives Windows resetting endpoint names on driver installs. Alternatives, in fallback order:
_place_values: keep = preserve minimized/maximized/normal | normal | max | min | left | right (half of the destination work area)
